title: Move configuration, launch and session lifecycle checks out of Dashboard Integrated UI Test

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-334#focus-detailed-dashboard-ui-checks at c7e680efb5c3108b877a93fe82d4c4b042278096

Verdict: Caught, on the path the check exercised (a refused Mark as done on a story card's session, in Dashboard Frontend Test).

Next proof action: none for this promise. No assertion needs strengthening and no journey proof is missing on this path.

Promise checked: Goal, "every distinct behavior those batches proved keeps a home that catches the same regressions", with Key example 2 (the mixed spec split). The interim spec dashboard/tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-done.spec.ts was split in 64e07ab2c. The successful mark on a session Claude Code no longer lists went to e2e/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-done.spec.ts. The refused mark went to dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-done.spec.ts, using the controlled done boundary (installFrontendSessionActions, refuseNext("done", ...)). Expected behavior: when the mark is refused, the session stays on its card, the entry says "The session could not be marked done.", Recently done stays empty and Mark as done is offered again.

Change from the suggestion: of the two faults the caller suggested, the refused-mark one was probed. It is the half that moved to a new home with a substitute boundary, so it is the conversion's riskiest preservation. The successful-mark fault (session kept on its card after a successful mark) was not probed; that path is still proved by the E2E spec, which was renamed into place with its card-removal assertions unchanged.

Fault: in dashboard/src/launchRecordActions.ts, markDone was changed so that when the boundary answers "refused", the record is replaced with a copy that has doneAt set to now — an optimistic done that removes the session from its card anyway. Fixtures and maintained assertions unchanged.

Maintained check examined: dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-done.spec.ts, "a refused mark keeps the session on its card and says so on its entry". Command: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npx playwright test --config dashboard/frontend.playwright.config.ts <spec> --reporter=list

Runs:
- Baseline: passed (1 passed, 3.5s test, 8.5s run). Scratch checkout clean before the probe. Load 5.53/6.28/9.25.
- Under the fault: failed at line 52, expect(entry.getByRole("status")).toHaveText("The session could not be marked done."), "element(s) not found" because the card entry had gone. Test time 15.0s. Load 5.87/6.25/9.10. This status assertion caught the fault; the later expect(entry).toHaveCount(1) was never reached.
- Independent witness of the wrong behavior: a separate untracked scratch spec with the same controlled setup and refusal, expecting card entry count 0, Recently done 1 entry and one done request after the refused mark. It passed under the fault (10.4s) and failed with the fault restored (expected 0, received 1, 17.3s), then was deleted.
- Restoration: git checkout of the one changed file and removal of the witness; git status --porcelain and git diff empty, matching the pre-probe state. The maintained spec passed again (5.7s test, 8.6s run). Load 11.36/7.47/9.35.
- Cleanup: scratch worktree /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/8d4e73bc/tmp/ic-scratch removed with git worktree remove. No edits to the execution checkout.

Prior disposition: matches the execution's own preservation intent for this spec, a split with the refusal at the Frontend boundary. The probe calls for no new repair. Observation, not a repair decision: the interim refused case also asserted dashboard.claudeStopCalls() was empty. The Frontend case asserts only one done request at the substitute boundary, and the spec header defers the refusal reason to dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/agent-launch-done-refusal.spec.ts. That reduction was not probed.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, Playwright list reporter per-test wall time: 3.5s baseline, 15.0s faulted, 10.4s witness under the fault, 17.3s witness restored, 5.7s restored — about 52s of test time across 5 runs, plus about 47s reported run wall time including startup. Dependency setup (setup-native npm, browser, check) not timed separately.
- Human effort: unavailable. Invoked automatically with no human interaction; no separate measure exists.
- Agent effort: unavailable. No token or turn count exposed to the worker; about 20 tool calls (estimated).
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 201137 ms (measured), from 1794718191383 to 1794718392520 Unix epoch ms; end clock sampled after writing the prepared report body.

---

Wrap-up disposition (checked revision c7e680efb5c3108b877a93fe82d4c4b042278096):
- Verdict Caught: no follow-up for the probed refused-mark path.
- Observation on the unprobed reduction: confirmed as a delivered coverage loss. No remaining test asserted that a done request refused for a missing project folder stops and runs no claude (agent-launch-done-refusal.spec.ts covered only unrecorded, other-project and malformed requests), contrary to the story restriction "Do not drop a distinct regression assertion when relocating a case." Repaired within this story before closure: dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/agent-launch-done-refusal.spec.ts "refuses a request for a session whose project folder is missing, without stopping or running claude" asserts 404, the folder-not-found message, unchanged claude calls, and the session unmarked and busy. Scratch breaks discriminated: skipping the folder refusal gave 200 instead of 404; running claude stop before the folder check added a {"argv":["stop",…]} call. No queued follow-up.
